question: Is the persisted producer snapshot of evaluation run 39813664201 (equivalently, the zero-delta resume snapshot of run 39820233238) complete, in-scope, pin-clean and internally reproducible, so that it can be audited as the v62 ordered-item-(1) shipped-planner verification plus ordered-item-(2) coverage-remediation cross-check without re-running either instrument under a changed frozen spec?
why_this_is_the_ordered_item: Factory direction v62 evaluation ordered item (1) required evaluation to re-freeze and re-verify the remedy-(a) repair against the NEW shipped planner after product landed it; ordered item (2) required the stand-ready cross-check of product deliverable 2 (the 4-of-24 query-coverage remediation). The producer run 39813664201 executed both instruments, committed the shipped-planner verification (exit 0) and the coverage cross-check (exit 0), but its agent step hit the 45-minute work quantum (rc-78) before audit. Run 39820233238 was dispatched as an operational resume of that snapshot and failed with exit 67 LEX_ZERO_DELTA_REPAIR: its snapshot branch is byte-identical to the producer branch, so it contributed no measurement and no state repair. This cycle resumes again and must verify the producer's completed work rather than restart it.
hypothesis: Six things hold simultaneously on the resumed tree: (R1) the resume base is the producer snapshot commit c87a33bc, an ancestor of this run's HEAD, and every path in the producer delta against accepted base 57ad380e is inside the evaluation lane write scope; (R2) every pin recorded in the two producer freeze records (shipped-planner remedy verification and coverage-remediation cross-check) still re-hashes to its recorded value on disk; (R3) both recorded producer results are internally consistent with their own artifacts (verdict and exit code agree, every frozen gate and control holds, the recorded hypothesis/freeze/planner digests match the files they name); (R4) the coverage result's reach unions recompute from the committed fresh-replay artifact and from the product mount's own committed live/offline evidence, with no reach loss against the committed offline union; (R5) the shipped planner hash recorded by the producer (9764a37e...) still equals the planner file at the current accepted product mount and the producer's product head 44330212 is an ancestor of the mount's current head, so the verified remedy has not been silently changed; and (R6) after this run's state repair, both evaluation state files are identical, carry this run id and direction v62, name as accepted_run_id the newest in-tree audited evaluation gate, keep every evidence_ref resolvable, and keep all admission/human-gate flags false.
baseline: the producer's own committed artifacts at snapshot c87a33bc: results/evaluation/shipped_planner_remedy_verification/39813664201.json and results/evaluation/coverage_remediation_crosscheck/39813664201.json (plus the committed fresh offline replay), with the two freeze records and the frozen retrieval benchmark 187b0e54... as the only pinned inputs. The current accepted product mount (lab/product) is read-only and is used only to re-hash the shipped planner and to recompute the coverage unions from the product's own committed evidence.

gates.R1_snapshot_identity_and_scope: the producer snapshot commit exists, is an ancestor of this run's HEAD, and the producer delta against accepted base 57ad380e contains no path outside evaluation/, tests/evaluation/, results/evaluation/ or reports/evaluation/
gates.R2_freeze_pins_hold: every path/digest pair in the two producer freeze records re-hashes to the recorded value on disk
gates.R3_recorded_results_internally_consisten: each producer result has verdict matching its exit code, all gates passed and all controls held, and its recorded hypothesis/freeze/planner digests equal the files they name
gates.R4_coverage_unions_recompute_without_rea: the union of per_text all_frozen_ids_reached recomputes to each committed coverage record's own n_frozen_ids_reached, and the fresh offline union is a superset of the committed offline union
gates.R5_shipped_planner_unchanged_at_current_: the current accepted mount's product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py hashes to the producer-recorded planner sha256 9764a37e... and the producer product head 44330212 is an ancestor of the mount's current head
gates.R6_state_reconciled_and_resolvable: both evaluation state files are byte-equal JSON, github_run == 39820650174, direction_version == 62, accepted_run_id is the newest in-tree results/audit/evaluation/CYCLE_<run>_GATE.json, evidence_refs_n == len(evidence_refs) with every ref an existing file, and all five admission/human-gate flags are false

controls.C1_planted_pin_drift_is_detected: flipping one expected digest in an in-memory copy of the pin map must make the rehash function report drift
controls.C2_planted_reach_loss_is_detected: removing one reached id from an in-memory copy of the fresh replay record must make the recomputed union disagree with the recorded count
controls.C3_planted_planner_mismatch_is_detected: comparing the recorded planner sha against a tampered actual digest must be reported as a mismatch
controls.C4_wrong_run_id_is_exit_2: invoking the instrument with a run id other than 39820650174 must return ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS and must never produce a product verdict

exit_code_contract.0: RESUME_VERIFIED_AND_AUDIT_READY - all six gates pass and all four controls hold
exit_code_contract.1: RESUME_DIVERGENCE - at least one gate fails (a pin drift, an inconsistent producer result, a reach loss, a changed planner, or a state defect)
exit_code_contract.2: ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS - missing inputs, a wrong run id or a failed control; never a product verdict

population: the two committed producer instruments and their recorded artifacts at snapshot c87a33bc, the frozen retrieval benchmark 187b0e54..., the product mount's committed coverage evidence and shipped planner, and this run's own reconciled state files. No new packet, no new bundle and no new retrieval are produced by this verification.
claim_ceiling: This instrument establishes exactly one thing: that the producer snapshot's completed v62 ordered-item-(1)/(2) work is in-scope, pin-clean, internally reproducible from its own committed artifacts, and that the shipped planner it verified is still the shipped planner at the current accepted product mount, so the snapshot can be audited without re-running either producer instrument under a changed frozen spec. It is NOT a new measurement of counter-authority recall, NOT a re-score of the mapping-free counter_authority_surface gates, NOT a label or geometry bar claim (both stay REPORTED-ONLY and unmet on the v3 bytes), and NOT a serve recommendation. It lifts no DO-NOT-SERVE order; admission stays fail-closed; human_gate_ready, machine_gate_ready, packet_admitted, ready_for_owner_session and owner_decision_required stay false. It re-derives no threshold, bar, rubric or verdict contract and runs no obsolete universal-174k benchmark. A NOT_APPLICABLE or NOT_MEASURED verdict from any label instrument is never a pass and is not consumed here.
freeze_first_disclosure: The producer artifacts were already committed when this resume began; inspecting them to diagnose the two failed workflows is unavoidable and is disclosed. This hypothesis and its freeze record fix the six verification predicates, the four controls and the exit contract BEFORE the verification instrument is executed on the resumed tree. The predicates are re-derivations from committed bytes, not new thresholds, and they were not adjusted after any gate result was computed.
network_policy: zero network. The verification reads committed files, runs local git plumbing and hashes; no retrieval, no model call and no OpenCaseLaw request is made.
determinism: SHA-256 file hashing, exact set membership and exact JSON field comparison; no RNG and no threshold.
